findings.issue: IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE only set .FALSE. and never observed a changed value
findings.resolution: set .NOT. h0 with no signaling operation, GET-confirm, restore, GET-confirm; plus a guarded row showing execution continues after a signaled exception with halting off

findings.issue: IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE only read the mode back
findings.resolution: 1.0/3.0 under IEEE_DOWN and IEEE_UP one ulp apart via IEEE_NEXT_AFTER, with GET-confirmed changes and restore

findings.issue: IEEE_SET_UNDERFLOW_MODE only read the mode back
findings.resolution: radix-guarded TINY(x)/4 subnormal under gradual and zero under abrupt underflow

findings.issue: IEEE_SIGNALING_EQ/GE truth tables omitted signed zero, infinities and signaling-versus-quiet discrimination
findings.resolution: sibling-consistent rows with IEEE_INVALID only for NaN operands and a quiet-NaN row separating them from QUIET_EQ/QUIET_GE
